body:
Confirmed: your reading is correct. Byte length and checksum are mandatory only for Produced roles. Every promised role still needs its role, intended portable path, media type, requiredness, and typed disposition/receipt; Failed, NotAttempted, or absent-by-semantic-contract roles must not carry invented byte metadata.

With that precision, my disposition remains ACCEPT on all six amendments. The off-tree draft is ready for chief-owned path, bead, and test-gate assignment; this is review acceptance, not implementation authority.
